results.answer: A platform operator approves a new project. It remains Pending Approval until they review it and change its status to Active.

A Project Owner has full operational access to the project, including inviting and removing members.

A Project User has mainly view-oriented access, such as viewing analytics, activities, and leads. They cannot invite or remove members by default.

1. Open the project you want to manage.
2. Go to the project’s member management area.
3. Search for the team member using their registered, verified user account.
4. Send the invitation.
5. The team member receives an email and an in-app invitation.
6. They must accept the invitation. After acceptance, they appear in the project selector with their assigned project role.

The project owner or an authorized member can send invitations.

A lead is a duplicate if:

1. The same email and phone already exist in the project.
2. The lead appears twice in the same CSV file.

Duplicates are identified during the import review before the leads are imported.

Pour créer un projet Crawllex, ouvrez le parcours de création de projet et renseignez les informations demandées :

1. Identité de l’entreprise : nom, site web, logo facultatif, adresse et contact.
2. Services ou produits et objectif principal de promotion.
3. Profil du client idéal et zones géographiques ciblées.
4. Objectifs SEO, comme la visibilité de marque, les prospects, la présence locale ou les ventes en ligne.
5. Noms ou URL des concurrents.

Le guide ne précise pas les boutons ou étapes exactes de l’interface. Si vous ne trouvez pas le parcours de création, contactez votre propriétaire de projet ou l’équipe Crawllex.

To invite a user to a project:

1. Select the relevant project.
2. Open Project Members.
3. Search for the user among registered, verified users.
4. Send the invitation.
5. The user accepts or declines it by email or in the app.
6. After acceptance, the active membership appears in the project selector with the assigned project role.

The invitation must be sent by the project owner or an authorized member.

لإضافة عضو جديد إلى المشروع:

1. افتح المشروع المطلوب.
2. ابحث عن المستخدم المسجّل والموثّق.
3. أرسل له دعوة عبر البريد الإلكتروني أو داخل التطبيق.
4. حدّد له دور المشروع المناسب.
5. انتظر حتى يقبل الدعوة أو يرفضها.
6. بعد القبول، سيظهر العضو النشط في محدد المشاريع، مع الدور المعيّن له.

يجب أن تكون مالك المشروع أو عضواً مخوّلاً لإرسال الدعوات.

General answer, not from your Crawllex data.

A canonical tag is an HTML tag that tells search engines which URL is the preferred version of a page when similar or duplicate pages exist.

Example:

<link rel="canonical" href="https://example.com/preferred-page">

It helps search engines consolidate ranking signals and avoid indexing duplicate URLs.

General answer, not from your Crawllex data.

Organic click-through rate (CTR) is the percentage of people who click your unpaid search result after seeing it.

Formula: clicks ÷ impressions × 100

For example, 50 clicks from 1,000 impressions gives an organic CTR of 5%.
